shop_menu.doc: The shop menu (M2-UI-06; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Shops and inns). Rects are top-left x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3 so every edge lands on a whole pixel at 1280 x 720 (as field_menu.json). 'root' and 'detail' are MenuPage metrics blocks; 'detail' (the buy or sell list) is as tall as its rows, up to max_rows, and scrolls past them. In 'detail' the MenuPage cost column holds how many the party holds (or who wears a piece) and the rank column the price. 'purse' is the right-aligned purse line in the title row. 'desc' (what the highlighted row is) sits at the top of the right column on the root, else 'gap' under the right page; 'status' (the cost of the deal, or why it is refused, in the danger color) sits under it. max_count is the most one deal may ask for with Left and Right. 'steppers' (M2-UI-26): the mouse's ‹ › count buttons, keycap-boxed, with the count between them (count_width), at the right end of the status line in BUY and SELL (width, height each; gap left between them and the status text). M2-UI-15: 'desc' height is a cap; the line is as tall as its text needs and the status sits 'status' gap under it.

inn_menu.doc: The inn menu (M2-UI-06): Rest (its price on the right) and Leave on the left; the line about the highlighted row in the right column, and under it the cost of a night or why the inn refuses. Same rules as shop_menu.

reefball_outfitter.doc: The Reefball outfitter (ADR 0040, M3-C07-05): the gear rows (price, Owned or Worn on the right) and Leave on the left, wider than the inn's for the longer names (1400 px: every name and the swap line fit at 130 % text and in the pseudo-locale, the Lead's final-quality pass 2026-10-29); the line about the highlighted piece (its words, then what it adds) in the right column, and under it what choosing it does or why not. Same rules as shop_menu.
